name: opencode-go
description: Lets Claude delegate tasks to OpenCode Go models, picked in an OpenCode panel with FREE and PAID sections and a reasoning level.

defaultModel.title: Default OpenCode Go model
defaultModel.description: Worker used until one is picked in the OpenCode panel (provider/model, or a bare id under opencode-go/).

orchestrate.title: Encourage delegation
orchestrate.description: Adds a short system prompt section telling Claude to hand routine work to OpenCode Go models.

fallbackModel.title: Fallback model
fallbackModel.description: Model a run switches to after the picked one keeps failing (429s, hangs). Empty: no fallback.

autoRetries.title: Automatic resumes
autoRetries.description: How many times a failed or hung opencode run is resumed before giving up (and trying the fallback model).

stallMinutes.title: Stall limit (minutes)
stallMinutes.description: A run that prints nothing for this long is killed and resumed.

dailyBudget.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudget.description: No new paid runs start once today's OpenCode spend reaches this. 0: no limit.

reviewModel.title: Review model
reviewModel.description: Model that reviews batch tasks when delegate_batch is called with review: true. A free model is enough.
